# goslop text fixture — two-field error record: the exception value is stored
# into an error field plus a note on the result object (httptap analyzer.py:262
# FP shape)
lang: python
file: record_error_step.py
---
def run_step(step):
    try:
        do_work(step)
    except Exception as e:
        step.error = str(e)
        step.note = "Step failed"
    return step
